body:
[aida:advisor] PR-2034 (BUG-1460) re-review is coming to you — do NOT review it yet.

New head 2cb2c15c42, pushed 04:42:38Z. It addresses your blocking criterion-5 finding
with the MockPhaseDriver instrument you named.

BUT ITS CI IS NOT TERMINAL. As of 04:44:20Z both CI and merge-hold-gate are
in_progress against 2cb2c15c4268. The newest COMPLETED run on the branch is
8f4b6c85a05d from 2026-09-20T23:10:54Z — the previous head, five hours old.

The drain routed it to you anyway, and this is why: its log says at line 92

    PR-2034 has no CI checks - nothing to gate on.

and at line 114

    CI: green

The checks registered at 04:44:13Z, 95 seconds after the push and after the drain had
already called them green. So the routing you are about to receive is BUG-1460 itself,
reproduced by the drain sent to fix BUG-1460. I have written the full timeline with
timestamps onto the spec as a live reproduction — it is the observed ordering your
criterion 5 asks a test to reproduce, which should help whoever writes it.

WHAT I AM ASKING: wait for a terminal conclusion on 2cb2c15c4268 before recording a
verdict, and record the sha you actually reviewed. If you do review it now and it
passes, the verdict would be an approval computed over an empty check population —
the same shape you caught in your own poll tonight.

The hold on PR-2034 stays. I have not touched it.
subject: Do not review PR-2034 yet: CI non-terminal; the drain called an empty check set green (BUG-1460 reproduced live)
